C0516.title: Java Decompilation Offensive and Defensive Practices: Exposing Code Leakage Risks and 5 Core Protection Techniques
C0516.summary: The article highlights that due to the highly standardized structure of Java .class files, attackers can easily reconstruct source code logic using decompilation tools like JD-GUI and CFR, leading to the leakage of core algorithms, business processes, and sensitive configuration information such as hardcoded keys and database connection strings.
